A directory of Australian laboratories and service providers for
**environmental toxin testing** (PFAS, pesticides, metals and more) and
**aquatic animal infectious disease diagnostics**.

::: {.callout-tip appearance="simple"}
## [Find a lab or service →](map.qmd)
Search the interactive map by toxin, pathogen, service, state or sector.
:::

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(plotly))
d <- read.csv("data/service_providers.csv", check.names = FALSE)
area <- ifelse(grepl(",", d$Tab), "Both", d$Tab)
counts <- as.data.frame(table(State = d$State, Area = area))
plot_ly(counts, x = ~State, y = ~Freq, color = ~Area, type = "bar",
        colors = c(Both = "#6a4c93", Environmental = "#2a9d8f",
                   `Infectious disease` = "#e76f51")) |>
  layout(barmode = "stack", title = "Providers by state",
         yaxis = list(title = "Providers"), xaxis = list(title = ""),
         legend = list(orientation = "h"))
```

Read more [about this project](https://www.frdc.com.au/project/2023-006){target="_blank"}.
